name: fn-structured-data-build
description: Build tooling for Faytuks Structured Data

scripts.lint:js: node --check assets/js/admin.js && for f in .github/scripts/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint: npm run lint:php && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:wpcs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run analyse && npm run test && npm run build:verify:full
scripts.commit: npm run lint:php && git add -A && cz
scripts.build:stage: mkdir -p .build/fn-structured-data/vendor/yahnis-elsts dist && cp -R fn-structured-data.php uninstall.php readme.txt src assets .build/fn-structured-data/ && cp vendor/autoload.php .build/fn-structured-data/vendor/ && cp -R vendor/composer .build/fn-structured-data/vendor/ && cp -R vendor/yahnis-elsts/plugin-update-checker .build/fn-structured-data/vendor/yahnis-elsts/ && find .build -name '.DS_Store' -delete
scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run test && npm run build:vendor && npm run build:stage && npm run build:zip && npm run build:verify && npm run build:cleanup && npm run build:vendor:dev
scripts.build:notest: npm run build:clean && npm run build:stage && npm run build:zip && npm run build:verify && npm run build:cleanup
scripts.deploy:local: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:stage && npm run deploy:local:push && npm run build:cleanup && npm run build:vendor:dev
